# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5253

# Review — PAN-5253
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — AC-7 visual evidence is not real: every "light" screenshot (1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10) renders the dark theme, so light theme was never captured

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5253-review-852dde43
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5253/.pan/review/agent-pan-5253-review-852dde43/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5253 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5253
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5268
- HEAD reviewed: 852dde43f559788ecad3d5527e4200800a1d110b
- Base: merge-base with origin/main = 2fcabc8af091 (32 files, +3595/−144). Prior cycle: none.
- Requirements source: the manifest's `acceptanceCriteria` is empty, so the PRD (`.pan/drafts/pan-5253.md`) FR-1..FR-10, NFR-1..NFR-7 and AC-1..AC-9 were used.

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] AC-7 visual evidence: the light-theme shots are dark, and the PR claims the AC is met — `.tmp/pan-5253/` (WI-7)
- Severity: ! (failure of an explicit in-scope acceptance criterion)
- Classification / requirement scope: validation gap; in_pr_scope. The "attached to the PR" half is a specification defect (see Fix).
- Trigger and changed-code connection: WI-7 / AC-7 require ten drawer screenshots. Shots 1, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 10 must be light theme; shots 2, 4, 6 and 9 must be dark. The PR body checks the box "Capture the ten drawer screenshots and report the four mechanical checks on the PR", and the PR comment says "all ten captured".
- Expected / observed / impact:
  - Expected: light shots show the light theme.
  - Observed: I opened `3-conversation-needs-you-light.png`, `5-details-top-light.png` and `8-changes-checks-light.png`. All three render the dark theme. `5-details-top-light.png` (215949 bytes) and `6-details-top-dark.png` (215953 bytes) are pixel-for-pixel the same dark image. Shots 1 and 2 also differ by only a few hundred bytes. The capture most likely only ever added `.dark` to a page that already defaults to dark, and never forced light.
  - Impact: NFR-6 (style-guide colours in both themes) has no evidence in light theme for any new surface: the banner slot, the Details cost column and Total row, the Ship diff line, the checks panel, the PRD view and the Status history view. The code uses semantic tokens throughout, so a light-theme defect is unlikely, but the evidence the PR reports is false.
- Evidence: static inspection of the PNGs in `/home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5253/.tmp/pan-5253/` plus their byte sizes. `results.md` there records only overflow and column checks; it does not record a theme assertion.
- Fix:
  1. Re-capture shots 1, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 10 with the light theme forced. Remove the `dark` class and set the dashboard theme to light in its own setting or storage key. Do not just skip `classList.add('dark')`.
  2. Assert the theme in the page before each shot, for example that `document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') === false` and the body's computed background is light.
  3. Look at each light shot for contrast problems in the new surfaces.
  4. Update the PR comment and say which shots were re-taken.
  - Spec correction: `gh` cannot attach binary images to a PR. Treat "attached to the PR" as satisfied by the workspace path plus the PR comment that lists the shots and the mechanical-check results. Do not block on that part.
  - Mechanical check 4 (the Stage tab is unchanged) was replaced by `git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD -- …/Stage`, which lists no file. I accept that as equivalent to AC-8.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [correctness] On Herdr, the banner's "Open conversation" stays disabled for a waiting review orchestrator — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/issue-view/useNeedsYouActions.ts:22`
- Severity: ~
- Classification: specification defect. The PRD's WI-3 prescribes `agentIds.has(sessionId)`, and the code follows it exactly. in_pr_scope, because the hook is new.
- Trigger: the server's issue tree builds the review-orchestrator node with `sessionId: reviewPane?.terminalId ?? orchestratorSessionName` (`src/dashboard/server/routes/command-deck.ts:470`). It sets `awaitingInput` when `reviewPane.state === 'blocked'` (line 478). On Herdr, the default backend, `terminalId` is a `term_…` backend handle, not an agent id (`packages/contracts/src/backend-pane.ts:31-37`). `useIssueView.deriveOperator` copies `session.sessionId` into the `awaiting_input` item (`useIssueView.ts:422-428`).
- Expected / observed / impact: the needs-you banner shows the prompt, but "Open conversation" is disabled with "The waiting session is still loading." for as long as it waits. The operator can still open the review agent from the strip's Review phase.
  - Work, worker, reviewer, test and ship nodes use agent ids, so they are not affected. tmux `terminalId` is the session name, so tmux is not affected either.
  - The cockpit hook resolves the item against the tree's own `sessionId`, so it works there.
- Evidence: static trace only. I did not reproduce it at runtime.
- Fix: resolve `item.sessionId` to an agent id before the check. Match `agent.id`, `agent.sessionId`, or the agent whose backend pane's `terminalId` or `id` equals the item id. `paneAgentKey` and `useBackendPanes(issueId)` already exist, so this needs no new data. Pass the resolved id to `onOpenAgentConversation`. Add a test with a `term_…` session id.

### [correctness] Checks view says "No pull request yet" when the check-runs request fails — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/issue-view/IssueChecksPanel.tsx:48`
- Severity: ~
- Classification: specification defect (the PRD dictated this markup). in_pr_scope.
- `fetchJson` throws on a non-OK response (`queries.ts:304`). Then `checks.isLoading` is false and `data` is undefined, so the heading falls through to "No pull request yet". The `shows the query error` test covers only an `error` field inside a successful response.
- Fix: branch on `checks.isError` first, for example "Could not load checks", before the `!data?.pr` branch.

### [docs] The ISSUE-VIEW Details order does not match the code — `docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md` (Details tab bullet)
- Severity: ≉
- The doc lists "…cost-breakdown disclosure, the Deft panels, the review specialists, a Ship section…". The code renders Pipeline (with `DeftSubagentRows` and the cost disclosure), then Review, then `DeftGatesPanel` and `DeftReviewCyclePanel`, then Ship.

### [requirements] The legacy page-density tab strip now shows Plan and Changes, and Artifacts can't be reached from it — `IssueDetail.tsx` legacy return
- Severity: ?
- Classification: specification consequence. The PRD moves `ISSUE_DETAIL_TABS` to the shared table and allows only the `PAGE_HIDDEN_TABS` edit in that return.
- Not reachable today: the only page-density consumer, `IssueMissionControl.tsx:778-781`, passes `showTabs={false}`. So FR-9 holds for every real consumer, and PAN-5246 deletes this return.

### [correctness] `@container` and fixed-position descendants in Details — `IssueDrawerDetails.tsx` root
- Severity: ?
- The author left the WI-4 "Open in" picker checkpoint unverified in a browser. Static trace:
  - `PanOpenInPicker` anchors its dropdown with `absolute` inside its own `relative inline-flex` wrapper, and closes on a `document` `mousedown` listener (`PanOpenInPicker.tsx:58,136,170`). The container query changes neither.
  - The direct Details children use no `MenuOverlay`, `fixed` or `ContextMenu` import: PickupGateControls, VerificationGates, UatEnvironmentPanel, ActiveAgentPanel, CostsTab, IssueDetailSections, UatStackStatus, ShipProgress, StatusNarrative, LinkedConversations and the deft panels.
  - The author's live check 3 confirmed that the drawer-level popover overlay still covers the title row.
- Evidence limit: deeper descendants were not traced exhaustively. A browser check of the picker would settle it.

### Advisories
- `IssueDrawerDetails` now re-renders every 5 s while Details is shown (`useSharedTick` default, 5000 ms). The work is bounded: six rows, plus a filter over the cost sessions for each agent row. This is not material.
- Stub-UI scanner findings, both mitigated:
  - `IssueBannerSlot.test.tsx:129` `return null` is a test probe component that calls the hook. It is not product UI.
  - `StackDrawer.tsx:22` `useState(false)` has a writer: the toggle button's `onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}`. `StackDrawer.test.tsx` exercises it ("summarises container health and opens the stack details").
- `LinkedConversations` returns from unmounted code. Its route `GET /api/pull-requests/conversations` still exists (`src/dashboard/server/routes/conversation-pull-requests.ts:113`) and is scoped in `route-scopes.ts:186`.

Non-goals: `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` touches nothing under `components/Stage/`, `inventory.ts`, `densitySections.ts`, `issue-view-no-loss.test.ts`, `IssueDetailShell.tsx`, `IssueDrawer.tsx`, `NeedsYouSlot.tsx`, `ConversationPanel`, `IssueActionMenu/*`, the server, `packages/` or `file-size-allowlist.txt`. No test was deleted, skipped or marked `.only`.

### Four dimensions
- **Correctness:** tab resolution, entry clicks and hidden entries are correct. The drawer store accepts free-form tab strings (`store.ts:260`), so `prd`, `checks`, `history`, `discussion` and the other new values persist and sync to the URL. Banner precedence matches D-7. Pane fallback ignores `ended` panes and never shows `pane.id`. The cost sum matches by `agentId` or `sessionId`. Two `~` findings are above.
- **Security:** no new trust boundary, no server change. New `<a href>`s come from GitHub check-run URLs and workspace service URLs, the same sources the cockpit already renders, with `rel="noreferrer"`/`noopener`. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. Nothing found.
- **Performance:** new polling runs only while its tab or body is mounted (NFR-1). Deft per-issue queries are gated by `isDeft` (`deft/queries.ts:51-68`). `useDeftIssueSummary` reads the one shared `/api/deft/issues` query (NFR-2). Re-rendering on the 5 s tick is advisory only.
- **Requirements and UX:** see the matrix below. The views use `ViewToggle` (`role="tablist"` with accessible names). `NeedsYouSlot` is unedited, so it keeps `aria-live="polite"`.

| AC-8 no Stage change | met | `git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD -- src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Stage` is empty |
| AC-9 quality gates | met | `overdeck/test` (typecheck and lint) pass; CI `lint`, `lint-group` ×4, `test-shard` 1-4, `test-e2e` and `build (22)` all pass at 852dde43 |

FR-9 (page, rail and Stage unchanged): met for real consumers; see the `?` advisory. FR-10 (console markers): `IssueDrawer.test.tsx` "renders every console inventory marker…" and "the marker table covers DENSITY_SECTIONS.console exactly" pass locally. `IssueDrawer.test.tsx` is not in the CI frontend subset, so this local run is the only evidence. NFR-3: the conformance-gates import-allowlist tests pass locally. That file's one failing test is pre-existing (below). ## Verification
- `gh pr checks 5268` at HEAD 852dde43: every job passes (`lint`, `lint-group` core/effect/skills/state, `test`, `test-shard` 1-4, `test-e2e`, `build (22)`, smoke, integrations, flake lane, `overdeck/test`). macOS jobs and Mintlify were skipped.
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: passed, 227 known findings, none new.
- Focused frontend vitest run on `src/components/issue-detail`, the four new `issue-view` tests, `IssuePipelineStrip`, `NeedsYouSlot`, `PrdViewer`, `src/components/drawer`, `Stage/cockpit/IssueMissionControl*` and `lib/__tests__/conformance-gates`: 249 pass, 50 fail.
  - All 50 failures are pre-existing. I ran the same files on an origin/main worktree (2fcabc8): 48 `IssueMissionControl.test.tsx` failures (unmocked `GET /api/issues/PAN-1661`), the `IssueDrawer` footer-actions snapshot (`issue-action-runOnDeft`), and the conformance truncation gate (`BookmarksDrawer.tsx`). The failure details are the same. None of these files are in the CI frontend subset.
  - The scratch worktree has been removed.
- Visual evidence: I inspected shots 3, 5, 6 and 8 directly.
- Not run: the full test suite (CI owns it), live browser checks (the Open-in picker checkpoint and light theme).

## Scope Note
The PR body checks every acceptance box, including AC-7, but the light-theme screenshots were never actually light. The fix is a re-capture with the theme forced, not a code change. The two `~` findings come from code the PRD dictated, so correcting them there would keep PAN-5246, which reuses these components, from inheriting them.
